content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for SCTIMST Project Technical Support II Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for SCTIMST Project Technical Support II?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Project Technical Support II post at SCTIMST is scheduled for 18 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time with all required documents.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Technical Support II position?
faq.answer: Candidates need a three-year graduate degree in Life Sciences, Applied and Interdisciplinary Sciences, or Physical Sciences, along with two years of research experience or experience in Public Health/Health Research/Health Care.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Technical Support II post is 30 years as of 01 August 2026. Age relaxation is applicable for candidates with experience in Government Research Organizations.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Technical Support II role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 20,000 per month, plus 20% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Project Technical Support II post?
faq.answer: The selection process may include a Written Test (if conducted, it will be of a qualifying nature) followed by a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Sree Chitra Tirunal Institute for Medical Sciences and Technology (SCTIMST), Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, 695011.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies of educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and category certificates (if applicable), along with recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, this is a contract-based job. The position of Project Technical Support II is offered on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
